subject: Pre-sweep decisions: sparsity, LRB scope
body:
Team,

Decisions from today's pre-sweep review:

1. Sweep design: we cover both sparsity regimes (10 and 50 tokens) across the full concept set, per Giannis' trade-off. Farah re-sized the job: it fits our vulcan-h100 week of 6/1 at 256 accelerators, at about 85% utilization — tight but no descoping needed.
2. Launch review scope: bias audit is the headline, single-image decomposition is the live demo, semantic manipulation is out (trust review flagged it needs its own privacy pass; not before 6/15).
3. Katya's 31 flagged profession concepts go to Kofi for counsel review in parallel — findings, not conclusions, in the LRB packet.

Sweep kicks off Monday 6/1, LRB on 6/15. Bring it home.

Priya
